findings.text: non-blocking: when runs.record_process_alive answers None (no pid recorded, a placed run whose scheduler cannot be queried, or an unreadable identity) the predicate returns True without calling turn_in_progress, so an unattributable resumed pointer suppresses the duty indefinitely; the docstring at :5029 says the run's own stream answers there, and the plan's condition for suppression ('its worker process alive and its turn not ended') is not what this branch tests.

non-blocking: assert _resumed["attempt"] == 2 compares the fixture's own returned mapping, whose _resumed_pointer set attempt = 2, against the literal it wrote, so it can never fail for a regression in the code under test and adds no guard.
